title: Darkshore 'Holy Diver' (87760) gives 0 XP on the beta
claim: The new Alliance Darkshore quest Holy Diver (id 87760, quest level 20, requires 15; kill a Stormscale Beastmistress for the Rod of Deep Dominion), capstone of the Beached Sea Creatures chain, currently rewards 0 XP; other level-20 quests in that area give about 1,550-1,950 XP.
detail: Reported on forever-bugs #399 (open, Pending Approval, no staff reply). Rewards otherwise: 5 Draught of Water Breathing, 5 Swim Speed Potion, 12s, +100 Darnassus (forevervsclassic). Until fixed, the turn-in is worth only the items: skip it in time-critical routes or treat its XP as 0. Likely a bug, so it may be fixed for launch; re-check after the Oct 21 test.

title: Night Elf Quickness (+2% speed) now stacks with Minor Speed and forms
claim: Since the Oct 15 build, the Night Elf racial Quickness (+2% movement speed) stacks with Minor Speed on boots and with shapeshift forms; before, a Night Elf with Minor Speed showed 108% run speed.
detail: forever-bugs #195 was closed with the 'Fixed' label on Oct 18; the reporter says 'changed in last build' and another player says the devs made it stack with everything, forms included. No Blizzard comment and not in the Oct 15 dev notes; check the character sheet (should read 110% with Minor Speed). Small but permanent travel gain for Night Elves.

title: RestedXP Forever dungeon guide: Alliance 17-18 HoT, 18-19 RoL, 19-20 Deadmines; Horde 16-17 RFC, 17-18 RoL, 21-22 WC
claim: RestedXP's Forever dungeon-leveling guide (free 1-20) now runs Alliance 15-17 Darkshore, 17-18 Hall of Thanes, 18-19 Ruins of Lordaeron, 19-20 Deadmines, and Horde 12-16 Barrens, 16-17 Ragefire Chasm, 17-18 Ruins of Lordaeron, 18-21 Barrens, 21-22 Wailing Caverns.
detail: Repo Guides/Forever/dungeon (Alliance-11-20.lua, Horde-12-22_Barrens.lua). Kami Labs (Oct 18) lists the paid 1-30 dungeon set: Horde RFC 10+, WC 10+, SFK 11+, BFD 15+, Ruins of Lordaeron 15-20; Alliance Deadmines 10+, Stockade 15+, Hall of Thanes 13-18, Ruins of Lordaeron 15-20, Wetlands excavation dungeon 24-29; optional dungeons are toggled in Guide Routing. Routes 35-60 come after launch. Earlier levels (15-16 HoT, 16-18 RoL, 18-20 DM) are out of date.

title: Beta ends Oct 21-22 at cap 30; launch Nov 4, 3 p.m. PST (23:00 UTC)
claim: The beta stays at level cap 30 until about Oct 21-22; name reservation Oct 27-Nov 3; WoW Forever launches worldwide at one moment, Nov 4, 2026 3 p.m. PST (23:00 UTC, 00:00 CET Nov 5); Invite-A-Friend week Nov 4-11; raids unlock Dec 9.
detail: No further beta cap raise announced; launch leveling is 1-60. Invite-A-Friend codes (upgrade packs) start arriving by email Oct 20; no recruit XP bonus has been stated. The stress test on Oct 21 wipes its characters (n:20261017-stress-test-oct21). Launch time from fan sites citing Blizzard's Forever page, which renders only with JavaScript.
